review.name: Vermillion Suzaku
findings: First pass actually inspected 24 raw source/battle head/body slices and 216 baseline actual technique frames. Anatomy remains coherent, but fire-strike and fire-breaker front views clipped the crest at 0.48 seconds. Applied Suzaku-only preview height 2.15 to 1.8, preserving all other 160 branches exactly.

Second pass actually inspected all 24 repeat raw slices, all 32 low/medium runtime transition slices, 216 repeated actual technique frames in twelve native strips, 24 advancing idle frames and sixteen atlas cells. Beak/crest/throat, wing roots, chest, both legs and tail remain connected. Zero clipped technique frames; minimum raster margin 29 pixels. Source, battle and atlas bytes unchanged. Whole roster and live release pending.
